name: Image Studio
tagline: Generate 512x512 plates on your box and keep them after an update.
description: Pick a Text-to-Image model, load it from the rail if it is not resident, write a prompt, get a PNG. The gallery lives in ~/.local/share/tiiny-image-studio/ so a farm update does not throw it away. One inference at a time, because that is what the hardware does. The rail shows NPU units used and free, and greys out a model that will not fit. It does not do background removal, outpainting or character sheets.

asks_for.why: to reach the Tiiny on your own network
plates are PNG files plus a JSON sidecar, one pair per image

privacy.stores: Generated PNGs and their prompts, seeds and models, on this machine only.
